answer: The yarrow receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a mesa seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. Sustaining that many identities means writing fresh texts against a target that moves every epoch, which means the work cannot be batched or cached in advance. That is 23 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
